description: Report what approval::gate WOULD decide for a function id (allow / deny / needs_approval) without deciding it: no pending record, no writes. Called by the harness before binding a trigger to an ordinary function, since a trigger-fired call runs outside any turn and cannot ask a human.

arguments.description: Call arguments, for deployments whose rules carry argument constraints. Defaults to `{}`.

session_id.description: Session whose effective settings apply (mode + always-allow list).

EvaluateVerdict.description: What [`crate::functions::gate`] WOULD answer for this call.

oneOf.description: Dispatches with no human in the loop.
Would hold for human approval — which a trigger-fired call, running outside any turn, has no way to obtain.
